jason-agraz.text: Lists "Safe Streets for Kids and Pedestrians" as a priority: "Every child walking to school... and every resident crossing our streets should feel confident that their safety comes first."

source.title: Jason Agraz for Wrightwood CSD (campaign site)

jason-agraz.text: Supports "thoughtful decisions that encourage responsible growth, strengthen our business community"; pledges to preserve Wrightwood's "peaceful mountain atmosphere" as the town grows.

source.title: Jason Agraz for Wrightwood CSD (campaign site)

jason-agraz.text: Backs programs that keep seniors and young people active and engaged in community life, and pledges to "Promote accountability and transparency" as a steward of public resources.

source.title: Jason Agraz for Wrightwood CSD (campaign site)
